I study labor markets shaped by high informality: informal employment, gender
differences, the reach of social protection, and equality of opportunity. My
work asks a practical question underneath all of these — who
ends up covered, who doesn't, and why.

## Policy and other writing

Short pieces written for non-academic audiences. Each links out to the
publisher.

- **The Gender Gap in Labor Earnings: Occupation, Hours, and Hourly Pay.**
  Banco de México, *Quarterly Report April–June 2026*, Box 2.
  [Read the summary](/policy/gender-earnings-gap-box/)

- **Why Support Breastfeeding at Work?** Inter-American Development Bank,
  Gender and Diversity blog, August 2022.
  [Read the summary](/policy/breastfeeding-workplace-policy/)

- **How Long Does an Informal Job Last in Mexico?** Undergraduate thesis,
  ITAM, 2017.
  [Read the summary](/policy/thesis-informality-duration/)
